new.title: New project
new.subtitle: The property location sets the sales tax, pricing and labor rates for this project.
new.name: Project name
new.description_placeholder: Scope of the job, style direction, notes…

start.title: What space do you want to remodel?
start.subtitle: Upload a photo and the AI figures out the room, the surfaces and the rough size. No measuring required.
start.dims_hint: Don't have a photo? Give us the rough size of the room and we'll take it from there.
start.where_hint: Sets local pricing, labor rates and sales tax. You can change it later.
start.analyzed_done: Got it — setting up your space…
start.source_soon: Coming soon — for now, start from photos or dimensions.

upload.title: Upload a photo of the space you want to transform
upload.hint: Drag an image, choose one, or use your camera. JPG, PNG or WebP.

analyze.adjust_hint: Adjust what you want to keep; you can also edit it in the editor.
analyze.dimensions_disclaimer: AI-estimated dimensions are not a certified measurement. Enter real measurements when you have them to sharpen the estimate.

overview.delete_warning: Deleting the project removes its rooms, images, scenarios and estimates.

takeoff.title: Takeoff
takeoff.subtitle: Measured quantities — how much work or material exists. The estimate reads from these; they never come from the estimate.
takeoff.empty_description: Add a quantity — from a plan, a manual measurement, or the 3D room — and link it to an item when you price it.
takeoff.label: What is this?

scope.title: Scope of Work
scope.subtitle: Group your items by trade. Each section can carry its own contingency and markup on top of its direct cost.
scope.empty_description: Add a trade section — Flooring, Painting, Electrical — to see its own direct cost, contingency and markup.
scope.name: Section name

files.title: Files
files.subtitle: Specs, scope of work, schedules and bid documents for this project.
files.empty_description: PDF, Word, Excel, CSV or image files — up to 8 MB each in demo mode.

settings.title: Project settings
settings.location_note: The location determines sales tax, pricing and labor rates. Existing estimates keep their snapshot and don't change.
settings.estimate_language_note: The estimate PDF can be generated in a different language than the app.
